title: Registry entry (schema v1)
description: The permanent record of one human in the Registry. Append-only in spirit: fields are added by events, never removed. Lives at registry/{registry_id}/entry.json.

registry_id.description: Nine digits, zero-padded. Assigned once, never reused. #000000001 is reserved forever; public numbering begins at #000000002.

era.description: Human-readable statement of the verification standard of the era, e.g. 'founding era — verified email'. Every record displays the standard under which it was admitted.

status.description: Memorialization is a status of a record, not the purpose of the archive.

chosen_name.description: Optional; may be a pseudonym. Anonymity is a first-class mode.

birth_era.description: Coarse, optional, offered by the human (e.g. a decade: '1990s').

birth_place.description: Coarse, optional, offered by the human.

annotations.description: Dated, sourced annotations added by STATUS_ANNOTATED events. Never alter testimony; they sit beside it.
